title: MediaTek Hardware Code to SoC / DA Code database
description: Merged HW-code observations from acon's explicit SoC mapping and mtkclient's hwconfig table. This is a research database, not a claim that every historical or unreleased MediaTek chip is covered.

field_definitions.hw_code: Raw 16-bit hardware code reported by BootROM/Preloader. Keep as hex string and decimal for searching.
field_definitions.soc_family: MediaTek internal SoC/platform family; may be a modem, IoT, tablet/TV platform, or application processor.
field_definitions.silicon_aliases: Silicon/platform identifiers and derivatives listed by acon or mtkclient; not all are separate dies.
field_definitions.marketing_family: Commercial family names associated by source; a single SoC may serve several Helio/Dimensity/Kompanio products.
field_definitions.da_code: Download Agent matching code. It is distinct from HW code and may differ.
field_definitions.hw_sub_code: Not populated in this table because it is device/stepping-specific and not a global per-HW-code value.
field_definitions.da_mode: DA mode from mtkclient config when explicitly declared; otherwise null.

acon.role: Explicit HW code <-> SoC, SoC marketing family, DA code mappings.

mtkclient.role: hwconfig entries, platform names, DA code/mode where declared.

records.marketing_family: Helio P65/G70/G80/G81/G81 Ultra/G81 Extreme/G85/G88/G91/G91 Ultra/G92/G92 Max
